items.t: Tsawwassen is a beachside Delta town beside the United States border and ferry terminal.
TFN lands lie northwest of the community, outside Delta's jurisdiction; its 2009 treaty covers 724 hectares.
Detached houses on Single Detached Residential 1 (RS1) lots are the core stock. At 5090 1 Avenue, one lot would become ten 468–911 m² lots.
Southlands adds detached cottages and estate homes near Boundary Bay Road: 950 homes on 537 acres, per Century Group.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Delta's zoning is Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017 (verified on delta.ca, 2026-11-03). It limits use, density, size, height and siting.
Delta adopted small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) zoning on June 24, 2024, for single-detached and duplex lots city-wide. A houseplex zone is being explored.
Delta's Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 8400, 2024, contains no Tsawwassen Area Plan. Farm land is designated Agriculture (A) — check current.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Avenue, occupies a former gravel operation. It lists a viewpoint, trails and water park.
Late French Immersion for South Delta is at Cliff Drive Elementary from Grade 6, serving Ladner and Tsawwassen.
Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre is being replaced; construction started summer 2025. The City lists a ten-lane, 25-metre lap pool.
A Coast-to-Coast Trail will link Centennial Beach to Fred Gingell Park, approved May 2026.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Houses: development and new projects

items.t: 10 Lot Residential Development, 5090 1 Avenue, applicant Hardeep Bassi: 27 duplex, triplex and fourplex homes. Status: first to third readings June 29, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).
Southlands, Market Avenue, Century Group: 950 homes including cottages and estate homes. Status: now selling, under construction (as of November 3, 2026).
56 Street upgrades, 12–18 Avenue, City of Delta: repaving, sewer, pathway. Status: repaving reported complete June 11, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).
Delta property tax is charged per $1,000 of net taxable value, due July 2, 2026, with a 2.9 percent 2026 City increase.
Flat-rate utilities for a single-family home total $1,658 in 2026. Delta bills them in late February; metered homes pay quarterly.
Treaty lands of self-governing Indigenous Nations are excluded.
Bus route 601 links Tsawwassen to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via South Delta Exchange and Highway 99, per TransLink's September 7, 2026 timetable.
The BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal, at Highway 17's southwest end, serves Swartz Bay, Duke Point, Departure Bay and the Southern Gulf Islands.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house?
faq.a: Yes, in many cases, because Delta's June 24, 2024 small-scale multi-unit housing changes allow a building permit for a secondary suite, garden suite or coach house on a single-detached lot without rezoning. Confirm the lot's unit count on DeltaMap first.

faq.q: Is a Beach Grove house flood-exposed?
faq.a: Low-lying Beach Grove lots sit behind the Boundary Bay dike, so check the individual lot first. DeltaMap shows flood protection, dike elevations and lot dimensions by parcel, and Delta received $2 million in provincial funding in 2023 for Boundary Bay dike raising.

faq.q: Which secondary school serves my street?
faq.a: South Delta Secondary serves Tsawwassen addresses, but check the exact street before relying on it. Delta School District No. 37 (SD37) publishes Tsawwassen catchment maps, notes that boundaries are reviewed and occasionally adjusted, and directs families to its School Locator for verification.

faq.q: Is nearby land Tsawwassen First Nation land?
faq.a: It can be on the northwest side, and City rules do not govern it. Tsawwassen First Nation holds jurisdiction over its 724-hectare treaty land base under its 2009 Final Agreement, separate from Delta bylaws, DeltaMap zoning and Delta property taxes.
